backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing products, orders, user profiles, and service quote management with admin‑gated retrieval and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing UI files, components, and test IDs related to removing Ontario references and fixing service‑area copy grammar.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Plaintext mapping of frontend file paths to short functional summaries for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and applying global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App router configuration defining storefront, cart, checkout, request‑quote, and admin routes wrapped in a theme provider.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with Manitoba service copy, contact info, navigation links, social icons, and Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with logo, shared service‑area subtitle, navigation links, and cart button showing item count.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering Header, Outlet content, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component showing product image, description, price, and link to the product details page with a fallback image.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/FaqSe: Renders a FAQ section using an accordion with predefined questions and answers about spray foam insulation.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Testi: Displays customer testimonials in cards with ratings, names, locations, and review text.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Trust: Shows four trust indicators with icons and labels such as licensing, estimates, efficiency, and warranty.
frontend/src/constants/serviceAreaCopy.t: Exports a constant string defining the displayed service area text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLeads.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update service quotes via the backend, including success and error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Provides hooks to fetch all orders and update order status through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Provides CRUD hooks for products, including create, update, archive, and restore operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Fetches the caller’s user role from the backend using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, handling login, stored identity loading, and state management.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Defines a hook to place an order with profile, products, address, and total amount.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Provides hooks to fetch active products and individual product details from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceQuotes.ts: Creates service quote requests and triggers UI toasts and query invalidation on completion.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode overrides, and global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Admin layout handling authentication, admin-role checks, and navigation for admin sections.
Displays and manages service quote leads with status updates and admin notes.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Lists all orders and allows admins to update their statuses.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Manages product creation, editing, and archiving through a dialog-driven UI.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays cart contents with quantity controls, item removal, total calculation, and an empty‑cart fallback.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Implements checkout form with validation, order submission, and redirect to confirmation on success.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows order confirmation details, including order ID, and offers a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Fetches and displays product details with quantity selection and add‑to‑cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/RequestQuotePage.tsx: Provides a service quote request form with validation, submission handling, and success confirmation screen.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Renders storefront hero, marketing sections, and active product listings with navigation to quotes or products.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Zustand store for cart items with add, remove, update, clear, and total calculation logic.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL/session parameters, including hash-based parsing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: JSON file capturing the project state, including summary, architectural notes, known issues, and existing feature definitions.
